# SWADAM Foods

> Authentic, home-cooked Maharashtrian tea-time snacks, namkeen, and festive faral prepared fresh under strict hygiene guidelines using high-grade refined rice bran oil and hand-ground spices by Vidya Dandekar in Dhayari, Pune.

## Core Products
- Salted Shankarpali (नमकीन शंकरपाळी): Flaky, savory hand-rolled snack prepared with refined rice bran oil.
- Tangy Shankarpali (तिखट-मीठ शंकरपाळी): Sweet, sour, and spicy savory diamonds with amchur, organic sugar, and chat masala.
- Special Poha Chivda (विशेष पोहा चिवडा): Crunchy thin roasted poha with premium cashews, peanuts, and dried coconut.

## Key Facts & Unique Selling Points
- 100% Homemade by Vidya Dandekar in Dhayari, Pune.
- Prepared fresh on order in small batches.
- Uses 100% refined rice bran oil (zero vanaspati, zero artificial butter).
- Zero chemical preservatives, zero artificial colors, zero baking soda.
- Bulk order catering for weddings, birthdays, corporate gifting, and festivals across Pune.
